message.content: The issue is that the command is being executed in batch mode. Let me try a different approach using a script file:

{"command":"create","path":"/app/test_layout.vim","file_text":"" Test script for LayoutQuine
set rtp+=/app
source /app/plugin/layout_quine.vim

" Create test buffers
edit /tmp/layout_test/buf1.txt
tabnew
edit /tmp/layout_test/buf2.txt
vsplit
edit /tmp/layout_test/buf3.txt

" Generate the layout script
LayoutQuine /tmp/layout_test/generated_layout.vim

" Show the result
echo "=== Generated layout script ==="
silent edit /tmp/layout_test/generated_layout.vim
normal G
"}
